name: canary
title: Canary MCP Server
description: Canary's read-only MCP source catalogue for Interactive Brokers: daily brief, portfolio and market evidence, broker reporting, reconciled FX contribution, earned stock-lending fees, indicative borrowing-rate and FINRA short-interest research, Edge review, rules, policy plausibility checks and action discovery. This catalogue follows main; new tools may precede the latest signed binary or MCP Bundle.
requires: IB Gateway 10.37+ or TWS running locally
IBKR Pro account with TWS API access
capabilities: detailed market regime and portfolio stress reads
earned stock-lending fee history and report coverage reads
indicative borrowing-rate discovery and dated market context reads
FINRA short-interest research with source dates and coverage
policy and settings plausibility checks against the live book

safety.summary: The MCP surface is read-only in every release variant. It cannot preview, place, modify, cancel, exercise, or transmit a broker action. Broker actions remain on explicitly confirmed CLI and paired-app paths.
